issues.title: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended.

items.snippet:
what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean wate

what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1K: Robot adding clean water error, task paused. Click to view the error reason/Error when refilling robot with clean water/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station. Check the sealing ring of the water outlet hole to ensure it is installed correctly. Shine a flashlight into the clean water tank hose to che

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has EB34: Auto Water and Drainage Module clean water pump abnormal, task ended. Click to contactcustomer service for assistance/Clean water pump of Auto Water and Drainage Module is in error/Smart water replacement module clear water pump malfunction?
Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

what should I do when T2080/S1 Pro has E23: Robot clean water level abnormal, task ended/Robot clean water capacity meter error/Robot clean water level sensor malfunction?
1. Remove the robot from the base station, remove the robot's dirty water reservoir, flip the robot vertically 360 degrees and shake it, then return to the base station to see if it has recovered.
2. Inspect the recharge sensors

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has E21: Robot dirty water pump abnormal, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Robot dirty water pump error/Robot sewage pump component malfunction?
Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has E20: Robot clean water pump abnormal, task ended/Robot clean water pump error/Robot clean water pump component malfunction/The S1 Pro robot shows a warning E20: clean water pump abnormal, causing the task to end?
1. 1. Please use the app to update the firmware of the robot to the latest version.
2. After the upgrade, use the app to start the Base Station Mop

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has E22: Robot dirty water pump abnormal, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Robot drainage pump error/Robot sewage pump component malfunction?
Manually return the robot to the base station, then select the wash mop option via the app. Wait for the robot to complete the mop cleaning process, then stop the drying function. Remove the robo

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has E21: Robot dirty water pump abnormal, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Robot sewage pump component malfunction/shows a "waste water drainage error" and flashes red?
1. Remove the robot's magnetic cover, take out the robot's dirty water reservoir, and check whether the dirty water sink is blocked. If it is blocked, please clean the

what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has E72: Robot movement obstructed. Remove surrounding obstacles/Robot movement obstructed. Remove surrounding obstacles/Machine stuck?
1. Move the robot to an open area, press the start/pause button, and check if the robot is working properly.
2. Remove the magnetic cover of the robot, take out the robot's dirty water reservoir, turn the robot over to check if t

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has Abnormal alert: EB33 Auto Water and Drainage Module clean water pump abnormal/Clean water pump of Auto Water and Drainage Module is in error/The clean water pump of the auto water modules is abnormal?
Restart the robot and unplug the base station power cord to restart and see if the corresponding error disappears.

What should I do if my S1 Pro/T2080 RoboVac cannot fill clean water from the base station?
If your S1 Pro cannot fill clean water from the base station, please update the robot's firmware to solve the issue. After successfully updating the robot's firmware, please make sure to complete the following steps: -Remove the robot from the base station. -Remove the dirty water tank from the base station.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has EB17: Base station clean water pump abnormal, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Base station clean water pump error/Base station water pump malfunction?
Please confirm whether any third-party cleaning fluids or disinfectants have been added, which may damage the water pump.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has EB16: Base station clean water pump abnormal, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Base station clean water pump error/Base station water pump malfunction?
Please confirm whether any third-party cleaning fluids or disinfectants have been added, which may damage the water pump.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has: EB32 Auto Water and Drainage Module dirty water pump abnormal/Dirty water pump of Auto Water and Drainage Module is in error/The dirty water pump of the auto water and drainage module is abnormal?
Restart the robot and unplug the base station power cord to restart and see if the corresponding error disappears.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has Abnormal alert: EB31 Auto Water and Drainage Module dirty water pump abnormal/Dirty water pump of Auto Water and Drainage Module is in error/Auto Water and Drainage Module dirty water pump error?
Restart the robot and unplug the base station power cord to restart and see if the corresponding error disappears.
